items.text: In Topic8 (Book 1: IAS),we mentioned that for Group 2 the solubility of the metal hydroxides increases down thegroup and thesolubility of themetal sulfatesdecreases down thegroup.Wecan now explain the reason for these trends in solubility.

items.label: text
items.text: As wehave mentioned earlier, the twofactors that affect the solubility of ionic compounds are the standard enthalpy change of solution of the compound,sqH,and the standard entropy change of the system, △S system·

items.label: text
items.text: It is diffcult to work out Ssystem accurately for many ionic compounds. We can use the standard entropy values of the ions as a guide.

items.label: text
items.text: The standard enthalpy change of solutionbecomes more negative down the group. This favours solubility as Ssuroundings becomes more positive.

items.label: text
items.text: The values of the entropies of the hydrated cations become less negative (i.e.more positive), and this also favours solubility.

items.text: Asbothfactorsfavour anincrease in solubility,the metal hydroxides become more soluble asyou go down the group.
